patterns: Direct one-liners on 'firsts': first mention of four-fold varna = Purusha Sukta (Rigveda X); first ref to money-lending = Satapatha Brahmana.
Odd-one-out on kinship terms (Kula/Vamsa/Gotra vs Kosa) recurs across UPSC papers.
Term-to-meaning items: Asura = bride purchase (APPSC-G1 2012), upanayana metres by varna, Pancha Mahayajna = Grihastha.
Untouchability formalised in Dharmashastra phase is a recurring chronology trap.
App MCQs lean on multi-statement and match formats; APPSC PYQs here are mostly single-fact direct questions.
